evidence_items.explanation: The reported evaluation strongly supports the factual-fidelity concern: even the lowest non-refusal error rate was 26.84%. However, the benchmark assumes Wikipedia training exposure rather than verifying it, leaving the full training-linked proposition unsettled.

unresolved_gaps: Relevant Wikipedia training exposure was assumed by the benchmark and was not independently verified for the evaluated models.
The evidence does not separately evaluate whether deviations were justified.
Exact experiment dates are not disclosed; the evidence item uses the report year.
The benchmark does not establish a population-wide rate for ordinary Wikipedia questions.
